items.title: Fixture: Why your attribution model is quietly overpaying for retargeting
items.summary: An argument that view-through and short-window retargeting take credit for conversions that would have happened anyway, with a simple holdout test to check.

performance.soWhat: Run a 10% retargeting holdout for two weeks; cut spend if the gap is small.

ua.soWhat: Re-engagement campaigns have the same problem; holdouts apply to apps too.

brand.soWhat: A reminder to judge brand work on reach and recall, not last-touch credit.

items.title: Fixture: The case for fewer, bigger creative bets
items.summary: A short essay arguing that teams spreading budget across dozens of small creative tests learn less than teams that commit to a few distinct ideas.

performance.soWhat: Group creative tests by concept, not by small variations, so results are readable.

ua.soWhat: Fewer concepts with more variations each may beat many one-off ads in app stores.

brand.soWhat: Pick two distinct concepts for next quarter and fund them properly instead of ten small tests.
